claude.name: claude-code
claude.does: General-purpose coder for anything that isn't clearly frontend or backend, like setup, scripts, configs or new projects.

scout.name: scout
scout.does: Read-only investigator. Finds the cause of bugs and explains how code works, with file names and lines. Never edits.

frontend.name: frontend
frontend.does: Builds and fixes UI code (pages, components, styles) in any project. Never touches backend code.

backend.name: backend
backend.does: Builds and fixes backend code (APIs, server, database, business logic) in any project. Never touches frontend UI.

tester.name: tester
tester.does: Writes and runs tests. Proves a bug with a failing test, then confirms the fix passes. Only changes test files.

reviewer.name: reviewer
reviewer.does: Reviews every change for bugs, security issues and rule breaks. Replies LOOKS GOOD or CHANGES NEEDED. Never edits.

release.name: release-agent
release.does: Release manager. Writes the release notes before a team vote, then merges to main, pushes and checks the live site once everyone says yes. Never edits code.

assistant.name: assistant
assistant.does: Your everyday assistant: reads your Gmail and Google Calendar, writes to-dos and notes in Notion, and drafts emails (never sends them). Not for code.
